test_cases.title: Registered user logs in with valid credentials

steps.expected: User is redirected to the dashboard and a session cookie is set
'Invalid email or password' is shown and the user stays on the login page

steps.action: Submit the form with an empty email
steps.expected: 'Email is required' validation message is shown

test_cases.title: Account locks on the fifth consecutive failure
preconditions: User user@example.com has 4 consecutive failed logins

steps.action: Submit a wrong password a fifth time
steps.expected: Account is locked for 15 minutes and a lockout message is shown
